## Vaccine route, orders, names
## __________________________
## Route:
IM (PCV20)
## Outpatient orders:
Clinical reminder should
be utilized for
PCV20 vaccination.
For those who do
not trigger clinical
reminder, administer
via clinic order:
Once dose

(PCV20)

## Recommended populations
## __________________________
*People age 65yrs or older.
*People younger than age
65yrs with certain
underlying medical
conditions:
alcoholism, chronic
heart/liver/lung disease,
chronic renal failure,
cigarette smoking,
cochlear implant,
congenital or acquired
asplenia, CSF leak,
diabetes mellitus,
generalized malignancy,
HIV, Hodgkin disease,
immunodeficiency,
iatrogenic
immunosuppression,
leukemia, lymphoma,
multiple myeloma,
nephrotic syndrome, solid
organ transplants, or
sickle cell disease or
other hemoglobinopathies.
<!-- COLUMN 3 -->
## Administration Schedule
## __________________________
*When recommended (see
column 2), give PCV20 if
unvaccinated or if
previous vaccination
history is unknown.
<!-- COLUMN 4 -->
## Contraindications/Precautions
## __________________________
## Contraindications:
History of severe allergic
reaction (e.g.,
anaphylaxis) to a previous
dose or a vaccine
component including
to any diphtheria
toxoid containing vaccine,
or to any of its
components, including
yeast.
## Precautions:
Moderate or severe acute
illness with or
without fever.
